item.title: Two UAE soldiers killed in helicopter crash amid Gulf tensions
item.description: ALBAWABA- The United Arab Emirates Ministry of Defence announced on Monday that two members of the country’s armed forces were killed when a military helicopter crashed during a routine national duty mission.According to the ministry, the crash was caused by a technical malfunction. Authorities said the incident was not related to combat operations and extended condolences to the families of the fallen soldiers. item.title: NATO intercepts second Iranian missile over Turkey
item.description: ALBAWABA- NATO air defense systems successfully intercepted a ballistic missile launched from Iran that entered Turkish airspace on Monday, the second such incident in under a week. Turkey’s Ministry of National Defense reported that the missile was neutralized over the eastern Mediterranean, with debris falling near Gaziantep. item.title: Four Iran-backed fighters killed in strike in Iraq's Kirkuk
item.description: ALBAWABA - At least four Kataeb Imam Ali group members were killed in northern Iraq after a strike that was blamed on the United States, the Iranian-backed group announced Tuesday.The Kataeb Imam Ali group revealed that an "American aggression" killed the fighters while they were in their position in the Debs district in Kirkuk province.

item.title: All JetBlue flights grounded by US aviation authority
item.description: ALBAWABA - The American aviation authority grounded all JetBlue flights, AFP reported Tuesday.The reason behind the decision is unknown, as no clarification has been made yet.The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) reported it was grounding all JetBlue flights after a request by the airline.The decision included all JetBlue flights to all destinations, the FAA added.

item.title: One-year-old baby killed in US-Israeli strikes in Iran
